import subprocess
# Use pdftotext to find page where Limitations appears
result = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
page = 1
for line in lines:
    if '\x0c' in line:
        page += 1
    if 'Limitations' in line:
        print(f'Page {page}: {line.strip()[:80]}')
        break
"

python3 -c "
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
page = 1
for line in lines:
    if '\x0c' in line:
        page += 1
    if 'Conclusion' in line and page >= 7:
        print(f'Page {page}: {line.strip()[:80]}')
    if 'References' in line and page >= 7:
        print(f'Page {page}: {line.strip()[:80]}')
        break
"
